question: Can the deployed factory use its documented free-tier model consistently across app, settings proof, and native gateway after repeated Gemini 3.6/3.8 capacity failures?

current_state.source_of_mismatch: docs/PROVIDER_POLICY.md and deploy/factory-v3/settings.json.example select gemini-3.5-flash-lite; prior generated workflow JSON had drifted to gemini-3.8-flash. Production currently runs 3.6 consistently.

target.model_metadata: Production Gemini key returned HTTP 200 and generateContent in acceptance/factory-v3/account-check.json.
target.free_tier: Official Google pricing lists standard input/output as free; current project billingInfo is false in acceptance/factory-v3/enabled-project-billing.json.
target.structured_output_and_thinking: Official model/API documentation confirms structured outputs and thinkingLevel support.

scope.app: Update the fixed V3 Gemini model URL and matching local settings example.
scope.gateway: Regenerate and publish only VIDEO-V3-Credential-Gateway from the reviewed source validator.
scope.private_settings: Change only free_tier_proof.model; preserve all credentials, project ID, tokens, DB URL, origin, and file mode 0600.
scope.preserved: All unrelated workflows, schemas, media, voices, quotas, Studio routing/auth settings, and paid-fallback prohibition.

preconditions: Commit and push runtime, generated workflow, and offline regression evidence before production changes.
Verify app image revision, active gateway model/version, billing false, active jobs zero, and protected workflow fingerprints.
If exact identities or protected-state snapshots differ, stop before mutation.
postconditions: Only the named gateway workflow is published, with active validator and model metadata URL both set to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
Only factory-v3 app runs the exact committed image; settings proof model matches and billing remains false.
All unrelated workflow fingerprints and DB counts match their pre-deploy snapshot.
Studio root remains public and factory-v3 health returns HTTP 200.
A separate fresh acceptance plan and unique ID must be committed before any generation/TTS call.
